raw:
@q query
  where all
    match
      relation "arrive in"
      role subject "Lucía"
      role object "Madrid"
      role time ?t
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "can take"
      role subject "Lucía"
      role object "the last metro to Alcobendas"
      role time ?t
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  compare ?t above 22h
